text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For an Umamusume, race results are more 
important than anything. However—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, coming from the oncoming lane. 
...Only "Commanders", right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today, there is something more 
important than the results. The place I 
headed with Neo Universe was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whirrrrrr)

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Regarding your 
X-ray results—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "All clear", I see.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are no abnormalities in either 
the bones or the joints.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: "Neo Universe, is something feeling off?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That uneasy feeling...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――"NOST." Neo Universe is on "Normal 
Cruise."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, the tension finally leaves 
my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made it through the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
without incident. Now, I can finally head 
toward the true 'GATE.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, our next "course" is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen is the optimal 
choice. Both the 'environmental 
conditions' and the 'interval' are close 
to ideal."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yet, amidst that transition—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the path toward the Takarazuka Kinen, 
the Neo Universe of another cosmos 
suffered a severe injury."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I haven't changed my 
trajectory. However, from here on out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—From here on, our journey with Neo 
Universe enters uncharted space."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I know the Takarazuka Kinen suits me. I 
know that, and yet—"
choice_data_list: Shall we open the door to summer?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Door into Summer— Let's just let 
spring pass by like this, and...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—From summer to autumn. If you're going to 
"drive out" to a calm domain—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I wanted to change the 
immediate goal and brighten the mood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A goal different from the alternate 
universes that didn't go well. By pointing 
to a star of hope, I want to lift their 
spirits, if even just a little.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)... If we can 
somehow 'drift ashore' there, Neo Universe 
and the others will..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That place wasâbeyond the "GATE".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we can reach it, it will serve as 
proof that we escaped the tragedy of 
another universe."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The goal is set. Now—there's only one 
"concern" left.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: How will we—"sense" the "GATE"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So that was the problem...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A serious ailment that put an end to Neo 
Universe's racing career."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How can I sense it……? Can it be avoided 
if I remain fully on guard?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We've roughly identified the coordinate 
time of the "GATE". However, the method to 
break through it has yet to be found."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even so, Neo Universe—sprints on.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Running alongside my Trainer. I will keep 
on running with Zenno Rob Roy."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Because that's what "XACF" is.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If you decelerate, you'll be caught in the 
"gravity well"... Keep maximum 
speed—through the "GATE".
choice_data_list: Ah, we just have to break through.
Yeah, we just have to break through!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as I remain an active racer, I 
cannot afford to slack off on training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Train at full power while searching for a 
way to protect Neo Universe. That is my 
ultimate mission."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finally, our desperate march into the 
unknown toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
begins.
